run_neuralfeels_main: run the neuralfeels entrypoint script with hydra config to start tactile SLAM training and visualization
run_optim_iter: run a single optimization iteration that performs map and pose optimization steps on the trainer
run_load_frames_incremental: run incremental frame loading to fetch new sensor frames and keyframes from the trainer
create_optional_display: create an OptionalDisplay context manager that conditionally starts a pyvirtualdisplay for headless rendering
review_optional_display_class: review the OptionalDisplay class that wraps pyvirtualdisplay with conditional activation via the active flag
